استفززت (form X)
# اِسْتَفْزَزْتُ (istafzaztu) /is.taf.zaz.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَفَزَّ (istafazza)
# اِسْتَفْزَزْتَ (istafzazta) /is.taf.zaz.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَفَزَّ (istafazza)
# اِسْتَفْزَزْتِ (istafzazti) /is.taf.zaz.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَفَزَّ (istafazza)
# اُسْتُفْزِزْتُ (ustufziztu) /us.tuf.
